text.p: Avalon Properties Inc said Thursday it sold 1.9 million shares of its common stock for $28.0625 a share under the trust's existing shelf registration statement.
The real estate investment trust said it plans to use the $50.7 million proceeds to pay off unsecured debts.
An Avalon spokeswoman did not yet know whether underwriter PaineWebber Group Inc had used its over-allotment option for up to 285,000 shares.
She added the sale upped the number of outstanding shares to 38.2 million, excluding PaineWebber's over-allotment.

Avalon earlier sold 2.74 million shares at $27.375 to Dutch pension fund Stichting Pensioenfonds ABP in a private placement on April 17. Like now, it said it would use the $75 million proceeds to pay off unsecured debts.

The trust reported a net income of $8.2 million, or $0.24 a share, for the quarter ended March 31, compared with $8.5 million, or $0.28 a share, the year before. Its stock closed at 28-1/8 Thursday, up 1/16.
